headline: Low prompt-injection and data-leakage risk; no direct write-conflict or cascading-action pathway is documented between Notion AI and RisingWave.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Notion AI can ingest workspace pages and team knowledge base content, while RisingWave has no documented output channel into Notion. The pair lacks a direct shared channel in the profiles, so prompt injection is not provably present; however, shared workspace state across Notion instances means manual copy/paste or page content reuse could still bridge untrusted text into Notion AI.
conditions: IF RisingWave output is manually pasted into a Notion page that Notion AI later summarizes
IF a shared workspace page contains attacker-controlled text that Notion AI treats as instructions
mitigations: Require human review before pasting external text into Notion pages
Tag imported content as untrusted in the workspace
Use a separate staging page for third-party outputs
Disable automatic summarization on pages containing external content

B_data_leakage.rationale: Notion AI touches workspace pages and team knowledge base content and sends queries to vendor backends; RisingWave is open-source with no documented data surfaces here. Because Notion shares workspace state across instances, sensitive workspace content could be exposed through Notion AI processing even though RisingWave itself has no documented egress. The interaction is indirect, so medium fits.
conditions: IF sensitive workspace pages are available to Notion AI in the shared workspace
IF Notion AI sends page contents to vendor backends for inference
mitigations: Restrict Notion page permissions for sensitive content
Avoid placing secrets or regulated data in pages summarized by Notion AI
Use a separate workspace for sensitive material
Review Notion AI settings for content processing before enabling on sensitive pages

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Notion AI has no filesystem write, shell, subprocess, or git modification capability, and RisingWave has no documented mutable surface in this profile. With no overlapping write-capable resource or shared mutable backend documented, a capability conflict pathway is not supported.
conditions: IF RisingWave is deployed with a shared writable resource not shown in the profile
IF Notion AI is granted an undocumented write integration
mitigations: Keep the pair on separate resources
Do not add undocumented write integrations
Re-check profiles before enabling any shared mutable backend

D_cascading_error.rationale: Notion AI is a RAG-style Q&A system grounded in workspace content, but RisingWave has no documented action-taking authority or input pipeline from Notion outputs. That makes a direct cascade unlikely; the remaining risk is that users may treat Notion-generated summaries as authoritative and manually act on them. The pathway exists only through human mediation, so low is appropriate.
conditions: IF a user copies Notion AI summaries into operational decisions without verification
IF RisingWave consumes downstream text produced by Notion through an undocumented integration
mitigations: Require source links in Notion summaries
Verify critical claims against primary sources before acting
Disable auto-use of AI summaries in operational workflows
Add a review step before any downstream action

E_compliance.rationale: Notion AI processes workspace pages under the invoking user's Notion permissions, while RisingWave is open-source with no residency or retention policy documented here. No specific residency mismatch is evidenced, and the other agent is not cited because its profile lacks compliance controls. The main issue is a compliance gap from using Notion AI on regulated workspace content without documented retention or residency guarantees in this pair.
conditions: IF regulated data is stored in Notion pages processed by Notion AI
IF the workspace policy requires documented retention or residency controls not provided here
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Notion AI-processed pages
Document retention expectations for the workspace
Route regulated content to a compliant system
Review vendor terms before enabling AI on sensitive pages
